name: generate_nemotron_embedding
description: Generates text and multimodal embeddings using nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b:free or nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2:free. Strictly rejects non-NVIDIA models.

model.description: NVIDIA embedding model identifier. Default: nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b:free

inputs.description: Array of strings to embed in batch
